g.text: M6: Apple Clang 21 · AWS: Clang 18.1.3 · -O3 · 16-byte members · 24 observations per cell
Dots: median batch-average ns/op. Whiskers: observed min–max. Lower is less time.
Corrected adapter only. Host/compiler/OS/affinity differ; noisy or short cells are coverage, not qualified optimization evidence.
